provenance: Offsets compensate Konnect issue #667: CPL Mid X/Mid Y carries the KiCad footprint ANCHOR rather than the component midpoint, so any footprint whose anchor is not centred lands off by the anchor-to-centre vector. IMPORTANT: these offsets are applied in BOARD axes (x_after = x + offset_x, y_after = y - offset_y), so a footprint-local anchor-to-centre vector must be rotated by the placement angle before being written here. Values below are the measured board-space anchor-to-pad-bbox-centre vectors: HDR1 (180 deg) +7.62, HDR2 (0 deg) -7.62, J2 (90 deg) +3.0 on Y — J2's vector is +3.0mm in footprint-local X, which its 90 deg placement maps onto board Y. J1, R1-R4 and C1 need no offset; their anchors already sit at their pad-bbox centres. SW1 is hand-soldered and excluded from the position file. All four placements are now confirmed against JLCPCB Component Placements by the project owner, over two preview passes on 2026-09-21. Pass 1: HDR1/HDR2 already correct at +90 (carried over from garage-console, same footprint); J2 sat displaced along +X, which exposed the board-axis error fixed in v2; J1 sat turned 90 deg from its pad row. Pass 2, after v2: J1 correct at CPL 0 deg (so its +270 stands, and the A-type/B-type variant question is moot), J2 correctly positioned but facing 180 deg out — the rotation added here in v3. Worth noting garage-console independently verified that a JST XH needs the same 180 deg, so this looks like a JST-family trait rather than a PH-specific quirk. REMOVE the offsets if Konnect starts exporting true midpoints.
